learning_objective: 🎯 Become an art detective and learn how to draw the big, beautiful world outside your window!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Before drawing a house or a tree, artists stop and look very carefully. They observe the shapes of the leaves, the lines on the road, and the colors of the sky.
Here is an amazing art trick: things that are far away from you look very small, and things that are close to you look very big!
A landscape is a picture of the outdoors. You can draw mountains, a busy city street, or a quiet park by putting different outdoor pieces together on your page.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Window View Masterpiece!
fun_activity.instructions: Look out of your favorite window at home. Pick the most interesting tree, building, or road you see, and draw it exactly the way it looks from your room!

quick_recap: ⭐ Artists observe the world carefully to catch all the beautiful details.
⭐ To show distance, we draw nearby objects big and far away objects small.
⭐ Landscapes capture the magic of the outdoors, whether in a city or a village.
